title: Podium
subtitle: The self-serve guide to Legend of Toys' people & performance system: profiles, the org chart, observations, wins, 1:1s, OKRs, appraisals and the people-data that stays private by design.

emp.label: Employee
emp.name: Employee (self-serve)
emp.desc: Everyone with a login. Sees their own profile and records their own wins; takes part in their own appraisal. No view of anyone else by default.

mgr.label: Manager
mgr.name: People Manager
mgr.desc: Anyone with people reporting to them (directly or down the line). Sees the full profiles of their reporting chain, logs observations and 1:1s, and reviews their team's appraisals. Manager powers come from the org chart, not a role.

hr.label: HR
hr.name: HR / People Team
hr.desc: Manages people, departments, roles, documents and org snapshots, and runs appraisal cycles. Sees everyone's full profile, including bank, ID and PAN that managers cannot.

adm.label: Admin
adm.name: Administrator
adm.desc: Everything HR can do, plus Podium's own roles & permissions, the user assignments, and system settings (including the salary vault).

parts.subtitle: What Podium is, how to sign in, find your way around, and exactly what your access lets you see.
The headcount dashboard, the directory, individual profiles, the org chart and adding someone new.
Your own performance page, the team feed, and the twice-yearly appraisal cycle from self-review to acknowledgement.
The role and KPI registry and the department structure that the org chart and appraisals are built on.
Who can see and do what in Podium, and the system-wide settings.
